title-page.purpose: One h1 per step or reference page.

subtitle.purpose: Card h2 and the app title.

mono.purpose: Rule IDs, option keys, inline code, file tabs and file content.

focus.purpose: All focus-visible elements; inputs use a 2px brand bottom border instead.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: One column; rail becomes a horizontal strip; preview below at 70vh.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Icon-only header actions, 16px page padding, rows stack.

components.name: Default Button
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:32px;padding:5px 12px;border:1px solid var(--stroke,#d1d1d1);border-radius:4px;background:var(--layer,#fff);color:var(--text,#242424);font:600 14px/20px 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.33,0,0.67,1);} .ds-btn:hover{background:var(--layer-hover,#f5f5f5);} .ds-btn:active{background:var(--layer-pressed,#e0e0e0);} .ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--stroke-accessible,#616161);outline-offset:1px;}

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per region: Download zip, Next step.
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:32px;padding:5px 12px;border:1px solid var(--stroke,#d1d1d1);border-radius:4px;background:var(--layer,#fff);color:var(--text,#242424);font:600 14px/20px 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.33,0,0.67,1);} .ds-btn:hover{background:var(--layer-hover,#f5f5f5);} .ds-btn:active{background:var(--layer-pressed,#e0e0e0);} .ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--stroke-accessible,#616161);outline-offset:1px;} .ds-btn-primary{border-color:transparent;background:var(--brand,#0f6cbd);color:var(--on-brand,#fff);} .ds-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--brand-hover,#115ea3);} .ds-btn-primary:active{background:var(--brand-pressed,#0c3b5e);}

components.name: Subtle Button
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:32px;padding:5px 12px;border:1px solid var(--stroke,#d1d1d1);border-radius:4px;background:var(--layer,#fff);color:var(--text,#242424);font:600 14px/20px 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.33,0,0.67,1);} .ds-btn:hover{background:var(--layer-hover,#f5f5f5);} .ds-btn:active{background:var(--layer-pressed,#e0e0e0);} .ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--stroke-accessible,#616161);outline-offset:1px;} .ds-btn-subtle{border-color:transparent;background:transparent;font-weight:400;} .ds-btn-subtle:hover{background:var(--layer-hover,#f5f5f5);}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Fluent input with accessible bottom edge and brand focus underline.
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;font:14px/20px 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;color:var(--text,#242424);} .ds-field>span{font-weight:600;} .ds-input{min-height:32px;padding:5px 10px;border:1px solid var(--stroke,#d1d1d1);border-bottom-color:var(--stroke-accessible,#616161);border-radius:4px;background:var(--layer,#fff);color:inherit;font:inherit;} .ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--text-3,#616161);} .ds-input:focus{outline:none;border-bottom:2px solid var(--brand,#0f6cbd);padding-bottom:4px;}

components.name: Step Rail Item
components.description: Wizard step link with icon; current step is brand-tinted.
components.css: .ds-rail{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;padding:12px 8px;width:232px;background:var(--layer-alt,#fafafa);font:14px/20px 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;} .ds-rail-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:36px;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-2,#424242);text-decoration:none;} .ds-rail-item:hover{background:var(--layer-hover,#f5f5f5);color:var(--text,#242424);} .ds-rail-item:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--stroke-accessible,#616161);outline-offset:1px;} .ds-rail-item[aria-current=page]{background:var(--brand-tint,#ebf3fc);color:var(--brand-text,#115ea3);font-weight:600;}

components.name: Badge
components.description: Pill status and metadata labels: neutral, brand, warning, danger.
components.html: Set on the repo root Recommended 3 Deprecated
components.css: .ds-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:20px;padding:0 6px;border:1px solid var(--stroke-2,#e0e0e0);border-radius:999px;background:var(--subtle,#f0f0f0);color:var(--text-2,#424242);font:600 12px/16px 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;} .ds-badge-brand{border-color:var(--brand-tint-stroke,#b4d6fa);background:var(--brand-tint,#ebf3fc);color:var(--brand-text,#115ea3);} .ds-badge-warning{border-color:var(--warning-stroke,#fdcfb4);background:var(--warning-tint,#fff9f5);color:var(--warning-text,#8a3707);} .ds-badge-danger{border-color:var(--danger-stroke,#eeacb2);background:var(--danger-tint,#fdf3f4);color:var(--danger-text,#b10e1c);}

components.name: Settings Card
components.description: White shadow4 card holding a group of option rows.
components.css: .ds-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;padding:16px 20px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--layer,#fff);box-shadow:var(--shadow-4,0 0 2px rgb(0 0 0/12%),0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0/14%));font:14px/20px 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;color:var(--text,#242424);} .ds-card h2{margin:0;font-size:16px;line-height:22px;font-weight:600;} .ds-note{margin:0;color:var(--text-3,#616161);} .ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 200px;gap:24px;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--stroke-2,#e0e0e0);} .ds-row code{font:600 13px/20px 'Cascadia Code',Consolas,monospace;}

components.name: Message Bar
components.description: Inline status with a tinted fill, stroke and status icon.
components.css: .ds-msg{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;margin:0;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--stroke-2,#e0e0e0);border-radius:4px;background:var(--layer-alt,#fafafa);color:var(--text,#242424);font:14px/20px 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;} .ds-msg svg{flex:none;color:var(--brand-text,#115ea3);} .ds-msg-warning{border-color:var(--warning-stroke,#fdcfb4);background:var(--warning-tint,#fff9f5);} .ds-msg-warning svg{color:var(--warning-text,#8a3707);}

components.name: File Preview
components.description: Signature: mono file tabs over the exact generated file content.
components.html:
# Formatting
[*.cs]
indent_style = tab
components.css: .ds-files{background:var(--layer,#fff);border:1px solid var(--stroke-2,#e0e0e0);} .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:2px;padding:4px 8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--stroke-2,#e0e0e0);} .ds-tabs button{min-height:40px;padding:8px 10px;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;background:transparent;color:var(--text-2,#424242);font:400 13px/20px 'Cascadia Code',Consolas,monospace;cursor:pointer;} .ds-tabs button:hover{color:var(--text,#242424);border-bottom-color:var(--stroke,#d1d1d1);} .ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--stroke-accessible,#616161);outline-offset:-2px;} .ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true]{color:var(--text,#242424);font-weight:600;border-bottom-color:var(--brand,#0f6cbd);} .ds-file{margin:0;padding:12px 16px;color:var(--text,#242424);font:12.5px/19px 'Cascadia Code',Consolas,monospace;font-variant-ligatures:none;} .ds-cmt{color:var(--code-comment,#5c7a5c);}

narrative.overview: The category standard, executed at Microsoft Learn and Azure portal craft. No distinctive identity: fidelity is the identity. Dense, quiet product UI for experienced developers. Labels and bullets, not paragraphs. Gray canvas, white layers, one brand blue. Real IDs, keys and file content are shown in Cascadia Code. Light and dark follow the system setting (prefers-color-scheme). No manual theme toggle. All tokens live as custom properties on :root in src/app.css. There are no component-scoped <style> blocks.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral canvas with white cards on Fluent shadow4
Brand blue only for primary action, selection and the active item
Fluent type ramp (12/14/16/28), weight 400 or 600 only
Fluent UI System Icons, 20px regular, inline SVG
Three-pane wizard: step rail, settings, live file preview

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Brand blue marks the primary action, selection and the current location. Nothing decorative.

rules.name: The Tint Not Fill Rule
rules.body: Status is tint background + stroke + darker text. No solid red, amber or green fills.

rules.name: The Mono Means Literal Rule
rules.body: Cascadia Code is for IDs, keys, file names and file content. Never for labels or headings.

rules.name: The Cards Float, Panes Don't Rule
rules.body: Shadows go on cards and popovers. Header, rail and preview use borders.

dos: Do use the :root custom properties in src/app.css; add a token there before using a new value.
Do use Fluent UI System Icons from @fluentui/svg-icons, 20px regular (16px small), through Icon.svelte.
Do show real IDs, keys and file content in Cascadia Code.
Do keep the focus ring: 2px stroke-accessible outline, 1px offset.
Do underline links inside running text (p, dd, .note, .caption).
Do write copy as short labels, one-line purposes and bullets.
donts: Don't use brand blue for decoration, headings or large fills.
Don't use solid status fills; use the tint trio.
Don't add shadows to panes, rows or the header.
Don't add a second UI typeface or self-host a UI face.
Don't use icons outside the Fluent System Icons set or emoji as icons.
Don't add a manual theme switch; follow prefers-color-scheme.
